name: Infosys Ltd

watch.text: Claims against the Group not acknowledged as debts, primarily representing India income tax demands.

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Management repeatedly lowered FY27 CC revenue guidance from 1.5%-3.5% to 1%-2% due to macro softness, yet operating margins remain resilient at 24% and cash generation is pristine (CFO/PAT 1.1x).

promises.promise: FY27 constant currency revenue growth target of 1.5% to 3.5%
promises.actual: Quarterly YoY revenue growth was 14.0% in Q1 FY27 and 10.7% in Q2 FY27 in INR terms.
promises.why: Guidance cut twice to 1.5-3.0% in Q1 and 1-2% in Q2 due to macro softness.

promises.promise: Revised FY27 constant currency revenue growth target to 1.5% to 3.0%
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 14.0% YoY to ₹42,279 Cr.
promises.why: Cut guidance further to 1-2% in Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Revised FY27 constant currency revenue growth to 1% to 2%
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 revenue stood at ₹49,244 Cr, growing 10.7% YoY in INR terms.
promises.why: Guidance reduced twice from original 1.5-3.5% target.

promises.promise: Maintain FY27 operating margin guidance at 20% to 22%
promises.actual: FIN reports Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 operating margin at 24.0%.
promises.why: Operating margin held at 24.0% in Q1 and Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Hire approximately 20,000 college graduates in FY27
promises.actual: Management re-confirmed target of around 20,000 fresher hires in Q2 FY27 call.
promises.why: Target maintained across Q4 FY26, Q3 FY26, and Q2 FY27 calls.

promises.promise: Build a team of 6,000 Frontier Engineers over next few years
promises.actual: Medium-term initiative announced; no numerical completion tracked yet in FIN.
promises.why: Medium-term target announced recently in Q1 FY27.

credibility.line: Management reliably maintains margins and cash quality, but has repeatedly cut FY27 revenue guidance due to macro uncertainty.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: FY27 constant currency growth slowing to 1%-2% target.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN shows Q1 FY27 revenue grew 14.0% YoY and Q2 FY27 grew 10.7% YoY in INR.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Operating margins maintained within 20%-22% guidance band.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN shows operating profit margin held steady at 24.0% through Q1 and Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Inconsistent disclosure on AI revenue contribution across quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Management withheld AI share in Q4 FY26, but disclosed 8.2% in Q1 and 10.5% in Q2.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Strong long-term cash generation supporting earnings reliability.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: CFO to PAT ratio at 1.1x over 5 years with ₹1,29,337 Cr total FCF.

bull.point: High quality earnings backed by robust cash flow conversion.
bull.evidence: 5-year CFO/PAT ratio is 1.1x with 5-year FCF of ₹1,29,337 Cr.

bull.point: Clean balance sheet with minimal debt leverage.
bull.evidence: Debt to equity ratio is 0.09 with interest cover of 97.1.

bull.point: Strong deal momentum and accelerating AI capabilities.
bull.evidence: Secured $5.2B in Q2 FY27 large deal TCV; AI at 10.5% revenue.

bear.point: Repeated guidance cuts reveal poor top-line forecasting visibility.
bear.evidence: FY27 CC growth guidance cut from 1.5-3.5% down to 1-2%.

bear.point: Substantial tax litigation and contingent liabilities risks.
bear.evidence: ₹3,117 Cr in contingent liabilities primarily for income tax demands.

bear.point: Regulatory investigation regarding US immigration and visa compliance.
bear.evidence: US DOJ investigating H-1B visa classification in immigration filings.

watch_next: FY27 revenue growth performance relative to revised 1-2% guidance.
Resolution or progression of ₹3,117 Cr tax liabilities and DOJ inquiry.
Execution of full-year fresher hiring target of 20,000.
